keys.note: Regtest test keys. priv is the integer, 32-byte big-endian. Not for mainnet.

cases.name: shared-price-expiry
cases.reorg_expect: disconnecting the completing-reveal block removes every item this batch created

cases.name: equal-ts-single-first
cases.note: A single order with this ts was applied first. Equal ts does not replace it.

cases.name: equal-ts-batch-first
cases.note: The batch item was applied first. A single order with the same ts and utxo does not replace it.

cases.name: older-batch-noop
cases.note: Re-inscribing an older batch does not revive or replace a newer record, including a cancelled one.

cases.name: newer-subset
cases.note: The newer batch replaces only the inscription it contains. The other listing stays.

cases.name: items-plus-inscription-id
cases.reason: items is an ignored unknown key; this is not a batch
cases.note: Detection (§16.3): both keys present ⇒ single order. The single order itself is valid.

cases.name: reveal-authorship-without-asig
cases.note: A reveal signed by the order key does not authorize a batch (§16.6 B4). There is no §7.1 fallback.

cases.name: body-over-32768
cases.note: 32768 is the maximum. 32769 is INVALID. There is no first-50 truncation.
